summary: The trial validated the existing edit-embedded-office-xml skill patterns for embedded Excel repair. Key lessons: (1) Slide text may contain 'DRAFT/superseded' vs 'FINAL/approved' corrections that need differentiation alongside existing archived/live keywords. (2) Buffer dilution matrices follow the same structural patterns as conversion matrices (row=source concentration, column=destination, diagonal=1, reciprocal formulas). (3) Package installation failures (externally-managed-environment) should immediately trigger XML fallback. Updated the skill to include these keywords, document the buffer-dilution variant, and enhance the helper script to target arbitrary worksheet paths since the hardcoded sheet1.xml failed to match the actual sheet2.xml target in this trace.
